S.FORM: alang Tida'an ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Toyohama go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 104 buwan, 245 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 65% kyan ku 159 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 35% kyan ku 86 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 59%, Kebalan 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 5%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. tay 'llaw na Tida'an hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Tida'an hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Tida'an hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Tida'an hya' ga llyung.
S.PHON: alaŋ ti*aʔan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu tojoħama ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** keβalan * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju taj ʔllaw na ti*aʔan ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na ti*aʔan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na ti*aʔan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ti*aʔan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ
